selection_rule: Unused provenance, study independence, exact gene/control/context compatibility, qualified existing predictor reuse, and cost. No SafeConf result/gain used to choose candidate.
scope: Local records and specifically referenced metadata/code only; a bounded audit, not exhaustive proof that no compatible public model exists anywhere.

axis_rule.note: Prior candidate intersections explicitly retain their3352 denominator; no numerical expression or output-axis repair performed. Low prior intersections bound current-subset overlap above and already fail.

orion_reuse.published_code_check: sf_orion_lm_predict rejects context_id != model$context_id; each model stores a separate baseline, training conditions, full-axis gene_emb and pert_emb.
orion_reuse.inference_inputs: Immutable query identity plus fitted context and existing gene embeddings; no new study conditioning occurs automatically.
orion_reuse.fresh_same_context_study: No eligible unused independent HCT116 or HEK293T study with verified identifiers, processing and controls was found in reviewed records.
orion_reuse.new_orion_batches: May be numerically unopened but remain same study and not proven independent biological units; freshness and access not certified; not chosen.

decoder_reuse.config: PerturBench DecoderOnly; use_covariates=True; use_perturbations=True; covariate_keys=[cell_type,treatment]; embedding_key=null
decoder_reuse.boundary: Metadata does not establish unseen-category support. Existing validation qualification plus fixed shrinkage depends on registered McFaline contexts and train-state means; no transferable H1 baseline/embedding is evidenced.

arc_H1.retained_role: Potential independent data candidate, not ready for confirmation
arc_H1.custom_gene_hash_split: Scientifically possible if full outcome-exposure provenance and absence of model/evaluator leakage are verified and split/predictions frozen prospectively. Official TRAIN naming does not prohibit investigator-defined holdout.
blockers: No verified compatible already-qualified H1 perturbation predictor checkpoint/output
Raw/source gene intersection and exact processing/control contract not yet verified
Whole-study outcome-exposure audit and model training-data provenance incomplete
Single H1 context requires explicitly scoped claim; does not create multiple biological contexts
obsolete_blockers_removed: Old10MB audit limit is not the user100GB resource cap
Absence of official public/private test does not itself invalidate a prospective custom split
arc_H1.no_claim: No assertion that all official channels lack models currently; local prior audit only, no fresh network search.

precise_next_boundary.within_current_scope: Use this completed metadata decision; do not open new expression, perform inference, fit, or rebrand current TEST.
precise_next_boundary.possible_no_new_fit_route: A compatible frozen published predictor could be considered only after its release, training provenance, context/target vocabulary, common genes, controls, checkpoint availability and competence evidence are concretely verified. No such pair is ready here.
precise_next_boundary.if_arc_requires_new_model: Requires explicit exception for one additional formal upstream fitting/adaptation attempt beyond2; prior100GB/96GPUh availability alone does not authorize that attempt. A H1-specific published linear fit is a new attempt even if CPU-only.
precise_next_boundary.risk_method_repair: Requires separate new-version scope for Source-risk fitting/representation changes under current freeze; preserve current failed method and fixed Orion result.
precise_next_boundary.resource_boundary: No general budget increase justified by this audit. Arc reported4.377GB could fit remaining total download budget, but this metadata-only task authorizes zero fresh downloads. Cost feasibility is not model eligibility.
precise_next_boundary.confirmation_boundary: Freeze new candidate, target cohort and information roles before any new outcomes; keep any later-study experiment distinct from original Orion confirmation.

scientific_readiness: Not established by asset availability or this audit; no method gain or replicated boundary law claimed.
